MATCH (b:Battle)-[:IS_IN]->(l:Location)-[:IS_IN]->(r:Region) WITH r, AVG(b.attacker_size) AS avgAttackerSize MATCH (h:House)-[:DEFENDER]->(b2:Battle)-[:IS_IN]->(l2:Location)-[:IS_IN]->(r) WITH r, avgAttackerSize, COUNT(DISTINCT h) AS distinctDefenderHouseCount RETURN r.name, avgAttackerSize, distinctDefenderHouseCount

MATCH (p:Person)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b:Book) WITH b, AVG(p.pageRank) AS avgPersonPageRank MATCH (d:Dead)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b) WITH b, avgPersonPageRank, AVG(d.pageRank) AS avgDeadPageRank RETURN b.name AS Book, avgPersonPageRank, avgDeadPageRank

MATCH (k:King)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House) WITH h, AVG(k.pageRank) AS avgPageRank MATCH (h)-[:ATTACKER|:DEFENDER]->(b:Battle) WITH h, avgPageRank, COUNT(b) AS battleCount RETURN h.name AS House, avgPageRank, battleCount

MATCH (p:Person)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b:Book) WITH b, AVG(p.pageRank) AS avgPersonPageRank MATCH (d:Dead)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b) WITH b, avgPersonPageRank, AVG(d.pageRank) AS avgDeadPageRank RETURN b.name AS Book, avgPersonPageRank, avgDeadPageRank

MATCH (p:Person)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b:Book) WITH b, AVG(p.pageRank) AS avgPersonRank MATCH (k:Knight)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b) WITH b, avgPersonRank, AVG(k.pageRank) AS avgKnightRank RETURN b.name AS Book, avgPersonRank, avgKnightRank

MATCH (p:Person)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b:Book) WITH b, AVG(p.pageRank) AS avgPersonPageRank MATCH (d:Dead)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b) WITH b, avgPersonPageRank, AVG(d.pageRank) AS avgDeadPageRank RETURN b.name AS Book, avgPersonPageRank, avgDeadPageRank

MATCH (p:Person)-[r:INTERACTS]->(t:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) WHERE r.book = 1 WITH AVG(p.age) AS avgPersonAge MATCH (all:Person)-[r2:INTERACTS]->(t2:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) WHERE r2.book = 1 WITH avgPersonAge, AVG(all.age) AS avgAllAge RETURN avgPersonAge, avgAllAge

MATCH (k:Knight)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House) WITH h, AVG(k.pageRank) AS avgKnightPageRank MATCH (h)-[:ATTACKER]->(b:Battle) WITH h, avgKnightPageRank, COUNT(b) AS totalAttackerBattles RETURN h.name AS House, avgKnightPageRank, totalAttackerBattles

MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF_CULTURE]->(c:Culture) WITH c, AVG(p.pageRank) AS avgPageRank MATCH (p2:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF_CULTURE]->(c) WHERE p2.gender = 'male' WITH c, avgPageRank, COUNT(p2) AS malePersonCount RETURN c.name AS Culture, avgPageRank, malePersonCount

MATCH (k:King)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b:Book) WITH b, AVG(k.pageRank) AS avgKingRank MATCH (kn:Knight)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b) WITH b, avgKingRank, AVG(kn.pageRank) AS avgKnightRank RETURN b.name AS Book, avgKingRank, avgKnightRank
MATCH (k:King)-[:ATTACKER_KING]->(b:Battle) WITH b.battle_type AS battleType, AVG(k.pageRank) AS avgPageRank, COUNT(b) AS largeBattles RETURN battleType, avgPageRank, largeBattles
MATCH (p:Person)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b:Book) WITH b, AVG(p.pageRank) AS avgPageRank, MAX(p.pageRank) AS maxPageRank RETURN b.name AS Book, avgPageRank, maxPageRank

MATCH (k:Knight)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House {name: 'Lannister'}) MATCH (k)-[:INTERACTS]->(p:Person)-[:HAS_STATUS]->(s:Status {name: 'Commoner'}) RETURN k.name AS KnightName, p.name AS PersonName, s.name AS BookName

MATCH (p:Person)-[r1:INTERACTS {book: 1}]->(tyrion:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) WITH p, r1 MATCH (p)-[r2:INTERACTS {book: 3}]->(robb:Person {name: 'Robb Stark'}) RETURN p.name AS PersonName, r1.weight AS InteractionWeight1, r2.weight AS InteractionWeight3

MATCH (p:Person)-[r1:INTERACTS]-(renly:Person {name: 'Renly Baratheon'}) WHERE r1.book = 1 MATCH (p)-[r2:INTERACTS]-(tyrion:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) WHERE r2.book = 2 RETURN p.name AS PersonName, r1.book AS Book1, r2.book AS Book2
MATCH (d:Dead)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)-[:DEFENDER]->(b:Battle) WHERE b.major_death = '1' MATCH (d)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b) WHERE b.name = 'Clash of kings' RETURN d.name

MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(g:Person {name: 'Gregor Clegane'}) WITH p MATCH (p)-[:INTERACTS]-(t:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) RETURN p.name AS PersonName, h.name AS HouseName
MATCH (p:Person)-[r1:INTERACTS {book: 1}]->(jaime:Person {name: 'Jaime Lannister'}) WITH p MATCH (p)-[r2:INTERACTS {book: 2}]->(robb:Person {name: 'Robb Stark'}) RETURN p.name

MATCH (p:Person)-[r1:INTERACTS]->(tyrion:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) WITH p, count(r1) AS interactionCount MATCH (p)-[r2:INTERACTS]->(jaime:Person {name: 'Jaime Lannister'}) RETURN p.name AS PersonName, interactionCount
MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House {name: 'Stark'}) WITH p MATCH (p)-[:INTERACTS]->(d:Dead)-[:DIED_IN]->(b:Book {name: 'Game of thrones'}) RETURN p.name
MATCH (p:Person)-[r1:INTERACTS]-(t:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) WHERE r1.book = 3 MATCH (p)-[r2:INTERACTS]-(k:King) RETURN p.name AS PersonName, k.name AS KingName
MATCH (h:House)-[:ATTACKER]->(b:Battle {battle_type: 'pitched battle'}) WITH h MATCH (h)-[:DEFENDER]->(b) WHERE b.battle_type = 'siege' RETURN h.name

MATCH (p:Person)-[s:SIMILARITY]->(g:Person {name: 'Gregor Clegane'}) WITH p MATCH (p)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b:Book)<-[:APPEARED_IN]-(t:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) RETURN p.name AS PersonName, s.character_similarity AS SimilarityScore

MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(rs:Person {name: 'Robb Stark'}) WITH p MATCH (p)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b:Book)<-[:APPEARED_IN]-(tl:Person {name: 'Tyrion Lannister'}) RETURN p.name
MATCH (d:Dead)-[:ATTACKER_COMMANDER]->(b:Battle {battle_type: 'ambush'}), (d)-[:DIED_IN]->(b) WHERE b.name = 'Storm of swords' RETURN d.name

MATCH (p:Person)-[:INTERACTS]-(k:King {name: 'Stannis Baratheon'}) MATCH (p)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b1:Book), (p)-[:APPEARED_IN]->(b2:Book) WHERE p.name = 'Jaime Lannister' RETURN p.name AS PersonName, b1.name AS Book1, b2.name AS Book2
